SysDataModelXML.SQLScript: SELECT S.[ID] LINKROWID ,S.[DOCNUM] --发票单号 ,S.DOCSTA --单据状态 ,DOCSTA.OPTDES DOCSTADES ,S.[DOCGRP] --单据分组 ,DOCGRP.OPTDES DOCGRPDES ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.[DOCDAT], 21) [DOCDAT] --单据日期 ,S.[SITE] --地点 ,SI.[SITENAM] SITEDES ,SI.CUR SITECUR ,S.[DEPT] --申请部门 ,D.DEPTNAM DEPTDES ,S.[GRP] --申请班组 ,G.GRPNAM GRPDES ,S.[RESNO] --申请人 ,R.RESNAM RESNODES ,S.BPSNO --商业伙伴（客户、供应商） ,BPSUP.BPSNAM ,S.CUR --币种 ,S.CURRAT --汇率 ,S.BVATTYP --商业伙伴税务类型 ,S.DOCDES --单据描述 ,S.[REMARK] --备注 ,S.PRJNUM --项目编号 ,S.CLOREA --关闭原因 ,S.PRNCNT --打印次数 ,S.[CREUSR] ,S.[UPDUSR] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.[CRETIM], 21) CRETIM ,CASE WHEN CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), S.UPDTIM, 21) = '1900-01-01' THEN '' ELSE CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), S.UPDTIM, 21) END UPDTIM ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') SABFLG ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') DEBFLG ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] = '1', '', '1') SUBFLG ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] = '3', '', '1') REBFLG ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] IN( '1', '2' ), '', '1') CLBFLG ,IIF(S.[DOCSTA] = '4', '', '1') PRTFLG FROM PINVOICE S LEFT JOIN LINKOPT DOCSTA ON DOCSTA.OPTID = S.DOCSTA AND DOCSTA.OPTTYP = 'DOCSTA' LEFT JOIN [ENTSITE] SI ON S.[SITE] = SI.SITE LEFT JOIN [LINKOPT] DOCGRP ON S.DOCGRP = DOCGRP.OPTID AND DOCGRP.OPTTYP = 'DOCGRP' AND DOCGRP.LINKOPTID = 'PIV' LEFT JOIN [ENTDEPT] D ON S.[DEPT] = D.DEPT LEFT JOIN [ENTGRP] G ON S.[GRP] = G.GRP LEFT JOIN [ENTRES] R ON S.[RESNO] = R.RESNO LEFT JOIN BPSUP ON BPSUP.BPSNO=S.BPSNO WHERE S. [DOCNUM] = '{0}' UNION ALL SELECT 0 LINKROWID ,N'#LINKDOCNUM({0},PIV)#' [DOCNUM] ,'' [DOCSTA] ,'' DOCSTADES ,'' [DOCGRP] ,'' [DOCGRPDES] ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 21) [DOCDAT] ,'SV' [SITE] ,'百隆越南' [SITEDES] ,'VND' SITECUR ,'' [DEPT] ,'' [DEPTDES] ,'' [GRP] ,'' [GRPDES] ,'' [RESNO] ,'' [RESNODES] ,'' BPSNO ,'' BPSNAM ,'' CUR --币种 ,0 CURRAT --汇率 ,'' BVATTYP --商业伙伴税务类型 ,'' [DOCDES] ,'' [REMARK] ,'' [PRJNUM] ,'' [CLOREA] ,'' [PRNCNT] ,'' [CREUSR] ,'' [UPDUSR] ,'' CRETIM ,'' UPDTIM ,'' SABFLG ,'1' DEBFLG ,'1' SUBFLG ,'1' REBFLG ,'1' CLBFLG ,'1' PRTFLG WHERE '' = '{0}'
SysDataModelXML.SQLUpdateScript: --LINKADDNEWROWS --LINKAUTOREPLACEEMPTYCOLUMNS MERGE INTO [PINVOICE] D USING ( SELECT N'@DOCNUM@' DOCNUM ,N'@DOCGRP@' DOCGRP ,N'1' DOCSTA ,N'@DOCDAT@' DOCDAT ,N'@DOCDES@' DOCDES ,N'@PRJNUM@' PRJNUM ,N'@SITE@' SITE ,N'@DEPT@' DEPT ,N'@GRP@' GRP ,N'@RESNO@' RESNO ,N'@BPSNO@' BPSNO ,N'@CUR@' CUR ,N'@CURRAT@' CURRAT ,N'@BVATTYP@' BVATTYP ,N'@REMARK@' REMARK ,N'@CLOREA@' CLOREA , N'#LOGIN_USER#' CREUSR , GETDATE() CRETIM ,00 PRNCNT ) S ON (S.[DOCNUM] = D.[DOCNUM]) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET DOCGRP = S.DOCGRP ,DOCDAT = S.DOCDAT ,DOCDES = S.DOCDES ,PRJNUM = S.PRJNUM ,SITE = S.SITE ,DEPT = S.DEPT ,GRP = S.GRP ,RESNO = S.RESNO ,BPSNO = S.BPSNO ,CUR =S.CUR ,CURRAT =S.CURRAT ,BVATTYP=S.BVATTYP ,REMARK = S.REMARK ,UPDUSR='#LOGIN_USER#' ,UPDTIM=GETDATE() ,PRNCNT=S.PRNCNT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DOCNUM ,DOCGRP ,DOCSTA ,DOCDAT ,DOCDES ,PRJNUM ,SITE ,DEPT ,GRP ,RESNO ,BPSNO ,CUR ,CURRAT ,BVATTYP ,REMARK ,CLOREA ,CREUSR ,CRETIM ,PRNCNT ) VALUES ( S.DOCNUM ,S.DOCGRP ,S.DOCSTA ,S.DOCDAT ,S.DOCDES ,S.PRJNUM ,S.SITE ,S.DEPT ,S.GRP ,S.RESNO ,S.BPSNO ,S.CUR ,S.CURRAT ,S.BVATTYP ,S.REMARK ,S.CLOREA ,S.CREUSR ,S.CRETIM ,S.PRNCNT );

SysDataModelXML.SQLRemove: DELETE FROM PINVOICE WHERE DOCNUM='#DOCNUM#' AND DOCSTA='1';
